site.title: Practice exercises
site.lede: Short practice for the ideas we cover in lab. Each one takes about ten minutes and fits on a phone. Pick one, finish it, then come back to the ones you missed tomorrow.

exercises.title: AGENTS.md or a skill?
exercises.goal: After this you can decide whether a piece of guidance belongs in AGENTS.md or in a skill, and say why in one sentence.

exercises.title: Write your own agent skill
exercises.goal: After this you can write a SKILL.md your agent finds on its own, and link two skills into one workflow.
